由于之前Pixiv和Patreon账号被删，所以作者不得不使用比较迂回的方式给出会员图包：
- 加入Discord后在“支援方法-support-methods”频道内找到他的patreon账号，购买当月会员(4.5€/月)/永久会员(9€/月)，其中当月会员仅可访问当月的内容，而永久会员可以访问作者现在和以前所有的图包(非常值!)。
- 购买完会员资格后，Patreon最新的帖子会给出txt文件，下载后复制文件内的密钥
- 返回Discord打开“monthly-plan”或者“all-time-plan”频道，打开给出的mega链接，输入密钥即可访问图包。注意密钥每个月都会变化。

Since the author’s Pixiv and Patreon accounts were previously deleted, he has had to resort to a somewhat roundabout method to distribute membership packs:
- After joining Discord, go to the “Support Methods” channel to find their Patreon account, then purchase a monthly membership (4.5€/month) or lifetime membership (9€/month). The monthly membership grants access only to that month’s content, while the lifetime membership grants access to all of the author’s current and past art packs (great value!).
- After purchasing a membership, the author’s latest Patreon post will provide a txt file. Download it, copy the key inside, return to Discord, open the “monthly-plan” or “all-time-plan” channel, open the provided Mega link, and enter the key to access the art packs. Note that the key changes every month.
